title: POV: A $600 Car Repair Hits… Jake Has $0, YOU Just Pay It 😳

lines: Six hundred dollar car repair. Jake has two hundred twelve.
scenes.img: a young man in a blue shirt in a car repair garage staring at an invoice in shock, hands on his head, vertical composition

lines: So it goes on the credit card. Twenty-two percent.
scenes.img: a young man in a blue shirt nervously handing a credit card to a mechanic, sweat on his forehead, vertical composition

lines: Almost three years to pay off. About eight hundred dollars.
scenes.img: a young man in a blue shirt at a kitchen table at night with a very long credit card statement rolling onto the floor, vertical composition

lines: You? Same repair. You just pay it. Calm.
scenes.img: {HERO} paying at a garage counter with a relaxed smile, mechanic smiling back, vertical composition

lines: Fifty dollars every payday. Sent before you even see it.
scenes.img: {HERO} tapping his phone that sends coins flying into a piggy bank, vertical composition

lines: Cancelled subscriptions. Sold four things. Fixed your grocery list.
scenes.img: {HERO} at home happily holding a box of old items and a shopping list, vertical composition

lines: Ninety days. Same paycheck. One thousand dollars.
scenes.img: {HERO} jumping with joy holding his phone showing a goal reached, confetti, vertical composition

lines: Full story on my channel. Because Jake's next six hundred dollar surprise is coming.
scenes.img: {HERO} waving at the viewer in a cozy living room, friendly smile, vertical composition
